answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed shortened onboarding flow across self-serve SMB. It improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention, directly supporting durable qualified revenue amid heightened churn risk. Do not respond with broad promotional pricing: the targeted-discount result produced short-term acquisition but materially weaker 30-day retention, and its source explicitly warns against treating it as sustainable growth. This does not fully neutralize price-driven churn, so that residual risk is flagged.
